{"timeline":[{"headline":"First Known Adult Animation","text":"The first known adult animation is Winsor McCay's 1918 film 'The Sinking of the Lusitania', which was a serious and dramatic depiction of the sinking of the RMS Lusitania during World War I.","date":"1918"},{"headline":"Fritz the Cat Release","text":"'Fritz the Cat', directed by Ralph Bakshi, was released in 1972. It was the first animated film to receive an X rating in the United States and became a significant milestone in adult animation.","date":"1972"},{"headline":"Heavy Metal Film Release","text":"The animated science fiction film 'Heavy Metal' was released in 1981. It was based on the magazine of the same name and became a cult classic for its adult themes and content.","date":"1981"},{"headline":"The Simpsons Debut","text":"'The Simpsons', created by Matt Groening, debuted as a series on December 17, 1989. It became one of the most influential adult animated series, known for its satirical take on American culture.","date":"1989-12-17"},{"headline":"Beavis and Butt-Head Premiere","text":"'Beavis and Butt-Head', created by Mike Judge, premiered on MTV in 1993. The show was known for its crude humor and commentary on youth culture.","date":"1993"},{"headline":"South Park Premiere","text":"'South Park', created by Trey Parker and Matt Stone, premiered on August 13, 1997. The show became famous for its dark humor and satirical take on a wide range of topics.","date":"1997-08-13"},{"headline":"Family Guy Premiere","text":"'Family Guy', created by Seth MacFarlane, premiered on January 31, 1999. The show is known for its cutaway gags and satirical humor.","date":"1999-01-31"},{"headline":"Adult Swim Launch","text":"Adult Swim, a programming block on Cartoon Network dedicated to adult animation, launched on September 2, 2001. It became a significant platform for adult animated series.","date":"2001-09-02"},{"headline":"Rick and Morty Premiere","text":"'Rick and Morty', created by Justin Roiland and Dan Harmon, premiered on December 2, 2013. The show gained a massive following for its unique blend of science fiction and dark humor.","date":"2013-12-02"}]}
